prompt:
Use this reference as the exact CHARACTER AND CAMERA. Paint a sixteen-frame, four-column four-row character action atlas. EVERY SINGLE FIGURE FACES LEFT in exactly this same FRONT LEFT three-quarter camera as the reference. Nose, chest orientation, and tool action stay toward the LEFT edge. No right-facing poses anywhere. Each row is a different action, but all rows keep ONE left-facing camera. Keep auburn braid, linen headscarf, teal embroidered coat, dark trousers, brown boots and leather gear identical. Whole painted figures, beautifully detailed.
ROW 1: Shield · awakening, empty hands, no physical shield, NO painted glow or effects. Four columns: near collapse on one knee with one hand over heart; lift head and open palm; rise to both feet with both palms opening outward; stand firmly protected with palms gently lowered.
ROW 2: Last Light · release, empty hands, no physical shield, NO painted magic effects. Four columns: draw hands close to chest and look toward aggressor; spread elbows as shoulders lift with resolve; extend open palms toward aggressor releasing the curse; lower palms and settle calmly.
ROW 3: Fall · study pose, empty hands, tools remain strapped to belt. Four columns: knees give way and shoulders sag; sink onto one knee using left hand on ground; roll gently onto hip and forearm; lie still on side with bent knees. Non-graphic, no blood. Keep same body scale throughout including lying pose, leaving ample horizontal room.
ROW 4: Last Light · curse reaction, empty hands, tools stowed, NO painted rune or magical effects. Four columns: upright looking ahead; flinch and glance upward toward an unseen mark above head; clutch chest and draw breath with knees slightly bent; stand weakened but alert. This is an inspection pose, no death.
Keep all sixteen bodies and tool tips fully separated, inside their cells, consistent body scale and boot baseline across each row. No captions, no text, no scenery, no ground or shadows. Truly transparent PNG cutouts.
